verdict.rationale: Morph's own docs publish concrete throughput and latency figures: Fast Apply at 10,500 tok/s, Compact at 33,000 tok/s, and Reflex classifiers at ~90ms. Its demos repo cites 4,500+ tokens/sec. These are headline numbers only, with no benchmark methodology, comparative benchmarks, or load-testing guidance showing how they were measured. missing for 10: published benchmark methodology or reproducible benchmark results, load-testing guides, latency percentiles/TTFT figures, independent or hands-on corroboration of the speed numbers.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides backing the provider's speed claims

citations.quote: Fast Apply merges just the changed lines at 10,500 tok/s, 98% accuracy.
Drop filler from chat history and code context at 33,000 tok/s.
Small text classifiers that label a turn in ~90ms
Use Morph's API to intelligently modify existing code at 4,500+ tokens/sec
